title: Twelve funny magical accidents
principle: Twelve distinct unintended magical outcomes. Ordinary cleanup and adaptation do not count as additional accidents. Spread them over several days, with quiet family scenes and each consequence given room to develop. PinPin remains energetic; concern, concentration, annoyance, surprise and laughter are earned and varied.

accidents.title: The bath that will not stop filling
accidents.attempt: Fill the bath without carrying buckets.
accidents.misfire: The little spring keeps running after the bath is full.
accidents.comicBeat: Papa puts down a bucket; it fills before he can pick up the next one.

accidents.title: Flowers instead of less water
accidents.misfire: Flowers and petals spread over the water.
accidents.comicBeat: Mama clears a patch to see her feet; another flower quietly opens there.

accidents.title: The duck answers
accidents.misfire: The previously ordinary yellow bath duck starts talking, without an advance hint.
accidents.comicBeat: More water! This is lovely! PinPin freezes; the duck sails past him.

accidents.title: A dozen ducks
accidents.misfire: One duck becomes twelve, all calling for more water.
accidents.comicBeat: Papa counts eleven. The twelfth is sitting in his bucket.

accidents.title: The flower that fills the room
accidents.attempt: Make the flowers small enough to gather.
accidents.misfire: One grows enormous, with broad floating leaves and a stem across the doorway.
accidents.comicBeat: Mama lifts a leaf to pass breakfast through. The family eventually finds it an outdoor home.

accidents.title: Bubbles that will not pop
accidents.attempt: Clear the surface of the bath.
accidents.misfire: Large, persistent soap bubbles lift the soap and loose washcloths.
accidents.comicBeat: Papa reaches for the soap, touches the bubble and sends it floating out of reach.

accidents.title: A raincloud under the ceiling
accidents.misfire: The lifted moisture becomes a little indoor raincloud.
accidents.comicBeat: Papa brings an umbrella to breakfast; the ducks gather beneath the rain.

accidents.title: Overhelpful towels
accidents.misfire: The towels start wrapping every wet thing they can find.
accidents.comicBeat: A towel-wrapped duck waddles past like a parcel, still requesting more water.

accidents.title: Slippers that swim away
accidents.comicBeat: He catches one; the other wiggles away. Papa waits with a laundry basket.

accidents.title: The floating breakfast
accidents.attempt: Lift a wet cloth out of the water.
accidents.misfire: The chairs and ordinary-shaped dining table rise a little too.
accidents.comicBeat: Papa steadies his hovering bowl with one paw and continues eating.

accidents.title: Water goes the wrong way
accidents.attempt: Send the stream out to the garden.
accidents.misfire: The stream climbs the wall instead.
accidents.comicBeat: The family holds buckets sideways while the ducks queue at the foot of their new waterfall.

accidents.title: A very small bath, the same big problem
accidents.attempt: Make the problem smaller after everyone is out of the bath.
accidents.misfire: The empty wooden bath shrinks to bowl size, but its spring produces just as much water.
accidents.comicBeat: A duck peers over it. Too small! PinPin can now inspect the complete glowing sign more easily.

resolution: A subsequent successful reverse gesture stops the original spring; restoring the bath is also a success, not a thirteenth accident. Resolve temporary effects along the way rather than keeping every effect active in one crowded scene. Keep the talking duck family and selected flowers, with suitable garden homes. End with ordinary family life and a small earned duck joke, not an exhaustion moral.
continuity: Four hedgehog family members; all share the broad green-quilt bed. The ordinary table remains round, even if levitating briefly. Wooden bath has continuous inner walls and floor. Ducks are yellow flexible plastic with white-and-black eyes and orange bills.
